text_block_list.text: Thank you very much for the day off.
choice_data_list: Did you get to fully enjoy it?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Yes, I ran through lots of places I'd been curious about.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: It might just be my imagination, but my legs feel lighter now.
Silence Suzuka seemed to feel refreshed in both body and mind.
